messages:
elaine: quick sync on marketplace launch + partner co-announce. need to lock embargo, partner quote, and landing page by EOD tomorrow.
ben: marketing needs final hero copy + 2 screenshots (console + purchase flow). can design ship tonight? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
priya: partner legal wants 48h embargo. are we flexible?
elaine: partner requested noon PT Tue. we were aiming 9am. thoughts?
marco: engineering: GCP listing needs final image + SHA before public flag. ETA image tomorrow 18:00 PT.
ben: if we move embargo to noon, marketing can finish by 9am and stage PR at 10. partner only gets 2h review then.
priya: partner legal requires ~8h. they can do morning review if we send assets tonight.
elaine: actions: ben ship hero + screenshots tonight; marco push image by 18:00; priya share draft PR tonight; legal-sara to review.
legal-sara: I can review joint quote + privacy blurb tonight. send PDF not google doc.
ben: draft hero copy: 
```nRedwood Inference on Cloud Marketplaces
High-performance LLM inference with enterprise controls.
CTA: Get started 0% free credits
```
ben: will attach logo lockup and alt text; making lightweight co-brand landing variant.
marco: note: marketplace SKU must include telemetry opt-out flag in listing. ops to validate.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging image pushed sha256:def456 (staging).
priya: partner asked to call out EU availability. ben pls add short line about regions.
ben: added "Available in US, EU (APAC coming soon)". keeping PR generic: "available on major cloud marketplaces" and list specifics on landing.
marco: Azure validation may take 24-72h. initial check passed but final acceptance pending image.
elaine: confirm Azure status?
marco: pinged Azure engineer; they said queued, final acceptance depends on image.
priya: I'll send draft now with highlighted lines for partner signoff and embargo confirmation.
legal-sara: also need trademark usage examples and partner logo approval.
ben: sharing secure PDF with assets to legal-sara via DM.
elaine: proposed timeline: assets tonight (ben), legal review by 22:00, partner review overnight, image by 18:00, marketing staging by 20:00, embargo noon Tue. flag if anyone misses slot.
priya: sent draft to partner and asked for trademark/logo confirmation + embargo OK.
marco: pushing final image now; will post final SHA when complete.
ops-bot: reminder: runbook check scheduled 17:30 PT for marketplace release 0: validate telemetry and autoscale.
elaine: reconvene here 21:00 PT for status tick. :thumbsup:
